title: POST /api/v1/cohort-sync/webhook/cohorts/{id}/members/add/
content: Add members to a CSV cohort. Accepted deltas are applied to identity data asynchronously. Re-adding a member is a no-op, so retries are safe.

content: Remove members from a CSV cohort. Accepted deltas are applied to identity data asynchronously. Removing a non-member is a no-op, so retries are safe.
